panels.description: At Keel’s pump station, restored water bursts into waiting jugs. Show only hands, containers, and water, never a recognizable crowd. Keep the normal-allocation display high-left, SPLASH—SPLASH low-left, and the queue worker’s balloon upper-right.

In the mine gallery, the original node pulses down its cable while a local shutter descends. Keep WHUM… WHUM… in a dedicated far-left mechanical zone attached to the shutter, clearly separated from the dialogue. Place Bi11bot’s first balloon upper-right, Alex’s reply bottom-right, and Bi11bot’s final balloon bottom-left.

Alex runs through the narrowing shutter gap with the tool bag over one shoulder and folded Bi11bot as a clearly separate bundle beneath the other arm. Keep the original node behind the grille. Put GRRRAAAK vertically along the far-left shutter edge; reserve dialogue upper-right and lower-right.

Alex reaches the colder side chamber as the shutter slams. Bi11bot unfolds against his chest; the same original node pulses behind the grille. Put CLANG on the far-left metal edge, separate from the dialogue in upper-right and lower-right.
